description: This file is a PHP web page script that manages and displays Ethernet port configurations for a network gateway device. It includes PHP code for server-side logic, database/config parameter retrieval, and embedded JavaScript for client-side interactions, as well as HTML for rendering the interface.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Function to determine if port 4 is enabled for XHS (XFINITY Home Security) based on MultiLAN configuration parameters.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Function that returns a descriptive label for Ethernet link status, considering various device settings and modes.
